Removes one current group membership. Human sessions only.

get.description: Lists active Web Yards for one workspace project.
Reads one Yard's effective visibility and active access grants.

Revokes one Yard access grant. Human sessions only.
Sets one Yard's visibility policy. Human sessions only.

get.description: Lists the current deploy followed by retained deploy history.

post.description: Marks an incomplete deploy as failed and schedules its manifest for cleanup.

Creates or reuses a Web Yard and reserves a manifest root for a public deploy.

get.description: Lists active environments for one Yard.

post.description: Promotes a retained successful deploy. Workspace administrator access is required.

get.description: Lists browser sessions for one Yard without exposing token material.
